sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2012
ORDINANCE III OF 2012
SINDH REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED
ON CONTRACT BASIS ORDINANCE, 2012
An Ordinance to provide for regularization of the services of certain
teachers appointed on contract basis through Institute of Business
Administration Sukkur
and Sindh University Testing Centre
Jamshoro in the years 2008 and 2009.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
31st January, 2012]
No.S.LEGIS:
1(3)/2012, dated 31-1-2012.---The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis
through Institute of Business Administration Sukkur
and Sindh University Testing Centre Jamshoro in the years 2008 and 2009 and to provide for
matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the Governor is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh Regularization of
Teachers Appointed on Contract Basis Ordinance, 2012.
(2) It shall come into force
at once.

2. Definitions.---(1) In this
Ordinance, unless context otherwise requires---
(a) "Act" means the
Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973;
(b) "Appointment of a
teacher on contract basis" means the appointment of a duly qualified
teacher made on contract basis;
(c) "Civil servant"
shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Act;
(d) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(e) "teacher"
means a person appointed as primary, junior and high school teacher through Institute of Business Administration Sukkur
and Sindh University Testing Centre Jamshoro in the years 2008 and 2009, on contract basis.

An Ordinance to provide for regularization of the services of certain
teachers appointed on contract basis through Institute of Business
Administration Sukkur
and Sindh University Testing Centre
Jamshoro in the years 2008 and 2009.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
31st January, 2012]
No.S.LEGIS:
1(3)/2012, dated 31-1-2012.---The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to provide for
regularization of the services of certain teachers appointed on contract basis
through Institute of Business Administration Sukkur
and Sindh University Testing Centre Jamshoro in the years 2008 and 2009 and to provide for
matters connected therewith or ancillary thereto;
And whereas the
Provincial Assembly is not in session and the Governor is satisfied that
circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the Governor is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
3. Regularization of services
of teachers.---(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in the Act or rules made thereunder or any decree, order or judgment of a court, but
subject to other provisions of this Ordinance, a teacher appointed on contract
basis and holding such appointment on the commencement of this Ordinance, shall
be deemed to have been validly appointed as teacher as a civil servant on
regular basis:
Provided that the orders
of the regularization of services of a teacher shall be issued by the
appointing authority subject to verification of his performance by Reform
Support Unit of Education and Literacy Department, Government of Sindh:
Provided further that
the services of a teacher shall not be regularized unless he has completed or
completes three years of his contract period and who does not possess the
qualifications prescribed for the post and his performance is not satisfactory:
Provided also that the
teachers whose services are regularized under this Ordinance shall not be
transferred from the schools for which they were appointed before the expiry of
a period of five years in the case of male and three years in the case of
female teachers.
